title: Free Mika (MIKA) copycats: LP pulled
facts: 9 'Free Mika' copies launched on Robinhood Chain Oct 28, 12:58 to 2:08 PM CT, copying the Solana pump.fun meme
On 3 traced copies the deployer added LP and pulled 100% of it 8 to 10 minutes after launch
All 9 pools have 0 active liquidity; DexScreener shows stale numbers · DB entry DD-036

title: ROBINHOOD copycat #2 bundle dump
facts: 6 wallets, deployer included, bought 83.87% of supply in the launch tx
Deployer sold its 16.66% in 13 sells over ~90 seconds; all six out within ~9 minutes
LP not pulled · DB entry DD-035

title: Anthropic (ANT) bundle dump

title: Million Dollar Homepage (1M) coordinated dump

title: Torch (TORCH) whale dump
facts: 3 wallets (0xecee…f01d, 0x7b04…1516, 0xe33e…08a5) sold ~23M TORCH (~2.3% of supply) for ~95 ETH
Sells landed between 4:12 and 5:34 AM CT, Oct 24 2026
Liquidity ~2.2M USD intact; whale selling, not a rug
